comment: AgentSmith slicer fleet for slice_check.py / print_send.py. 'default_printer' is used when the user doesn't name one — the agent must then OFFER the other keys in its report. Profile names are resolved inside OrcaSlicer's bundled resources (auto-extracted once from the AppImage into ~/.cache/agentsmith-orca/profiles; the preset 'inherits' chain is flattened because the CLI doesn't resolve it for by-path presets). CORE One tip: process '0.20mm STRUCTURAL @CORE One 0.4' is the better choice for load-bearing parts — mention it when relevant. 'ston_wolf' is a custom machine; the user supplies its profiles at home (fill machine/process/filament, remove 'unconfigured'). 'network' blocks feed print_send.py — hosts get filled in at home.

ston_wolf.label: Ston WOLF (custom)
ston_wolf.note: Custom printer — the user will supply its OrcaSlicer profiles at home. Until then slicing for it is unavailable; say so and offer core_one/qidi_max3 instead.
